data.title: Doximity’s Strong Results, Raised Outlook and AI Growth Support Buy Rating
data.description:
William Blair analyst Ryan Daniels has maintained their bullish stance on DOCS stock, giving a Buy rating today.

Ryan Daniels gave his rating based on several factors, including Doximity’s broad reach among U.S. physicians, strong engagement, and strategically important relationships with leading healthcare organizations and pharmaceutical companies. The latest quarterly results exceeded expectations for revenue and adjusted EBITDA, while management also raised its full-year outlook, reinforcing confidence in the company’s operating momentum.

Daniels also viewed Doximity’s expanding AI capabilities as a significant long-term growth opportunity, with more than 190 health systems adopting its AI suite and further clinical-content enhancements underway. Although pharmaceutical marketing budgets remain uneven, he believed conditions were improving and that the company’s competitive position, continued share gains, and valuation near 18 times projected 2027 adjusted EBITDA supported a Buy rating.

data.title: Snap’s Mixed Q3 Performance Supports a Hold Rating and $6 Price Target
data.description:
Maria Ripps, an analyst from Canaccord Genuity, maintained the Hold rating on Snap. The associated price target is $6.00.

Maria Ripps’s rating is based on a combination of factors, including Snap’s uneven third-quarter performance. Advertising growth weakened as brand demand declined, and daily-user expansion remained modest, with North American and European users still below prior-year levels. These trends create uncertainty about the pace of future audience and revenue growth.
At the same time, stronger gross margins, cost discipline, cash flow, and subscription growth demonstrate meaningful operating progress. However, the potential of Specs remains unproven, while management expects brand advertising to recover only over time. With these positives balanced against execution and valuation risks, Ripps believes the shares warrant a Hold rating and a $6 price target.

In another report released yesterday, Cantor Fitzgerald also maintained a Hold rating on the stock with a $5.00 price target.
